tasks.name: Identity and permissions
tasks.goal: Validate agent identity, root path and allowed operations.

tasks.name: Mother Law 2558 gate
tasks.goal: Check law artifacts and never infer project PASS from partial checks.

tasks.name: Project discovery
tasks.goal: Inventory bounded project files and hash eligible files.

tasks.name: Central planner
tasks.goal: Prioritize blocked prerequisites before dependent tasks.

tasks.name: Task management
tasks.goal: Persist section tasks and resume statuses without duplicate tasks.

tasks.name: Controlled code execution
tasks.goal: Run bounded syntax checks only; never run arbitrary package scripts.

tasks.name: Brain and experience memory
tasks.goal: Persist verified observations and evidence references.

tasks.name: Cell-life engine
tasks.goal: Locate cell engine and tests; do not claim live cell health without runtime evidence.

tasks.name: Neural engine
tasks.goal: Locate neural modules and tests; inspect wiring before claiming integration.

tasks.name: P2P networking
tasks.goal: Locate P2P modules/tests; loopback is not proof of independent nodes.

tasks.name: Server and APIs
tasks.goal: Inventory server/API code; do not kill or restart unrelated processes.

tasks.name: UI, wallet, market and APK
tasks.goal: Locate UI/build artifacts; never claim install or transaction success from source alone.

tasks.name: Math, geometry and physics
tasks.goal: Locate computational modules/tests; require reference tests for correctness.

tasks.name: Security
tasks.goal: Avoid secrets in evidence; flag risky patterns for review without executing them.

tasks.name: Backup audit and deduplication
tasks.goal: Inventory only; never delete backups or infer duplicates from names alone.

tasks.name: Persistence and resume
tasks.goal: Use atomic state writes and resume after interruption.

tasks.name: Independent verification
tasks.goal: Report exact verified scope and leave project-wide status unclaimed.
